entries.name: Quaternius Animated Characters Pack — selected new bodies and derived FPS arms
entries.author: Quaternius
entries.version: Archive root: Ultimate Animated Character Pack - Nov 2019; author published on OGA 2021-06-18
entries.licenseEvidence: Publisher page explicitly lists CC0; ZIP has no standalone licence file. Retained licence-source record is project-authored and marked as such, plus unmodified official CC0 legal text.
entries.usedFor: Four new full-body class models, three ordinary-enemy bodies, new skinned arms derived from BlueSoldier. No old project body/arms mesh reused.
entries.modifications: Blender normalized to 1.8m Idle, feet-root, +Z facing; source 17 animation clips retained in full bodies. FPS removes non-arm geometry, retains 606 source vertices, uses true renamed hand/forearm bones and new palm contacts; no authored FPS reload clip claimed. Original source BSDF flat colours restored explicitly through material_palette_bridge; all non-material JSON and animation/geometry/skin BIN unchanged; original files and GUIDs retained.
entries.verification: Actual Unity import/build and focused native model/route evidence are recorded in docs/models-final.zh-CN.md; source palette reports under Tools/VisualAuthoring
